description: We are team witch aim's to build open tools for astronauts and hobbyists. If you have any questions, please contact us.
summary: We have developed an interactive health management system for astronauts. It features separate views for the astronaut, the commander and ground control. Our project comprises an ASP.NET server and a SolidJS front-end, as well as enclosure designs and PCB layouts. Our solution is designed to handle 20 signals, 14 of which are used to predict health status using our own neural network (built using the PyTorch framework).
